data.body: Blocked on amoeboid-amateur-guillemot (1768-5b6f-958a-43e9), recorded as an epic-level dependency by the tracker. As written, this story cannot pass `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py::test_the_committed_baseline_matches_the_live_tree`: it removes two `env_var` rows and adds the marked `tests/_child_hooks.py` helper in one tree, and `--update-stale` on origin/main refuses whenever `compare()` sees a new mechanism, marker or not (`scripts/check_mechanism_delta.py:177-195`, `scripts/_mechanism_delta/compare.py:45-57`). Once that bug's fix lands, the sequence in this story's ratchet comment works as stated: add the marker, run `--update-stale` (drops the two env rows, leaves the admitted helper out of the baseline), commit. Do not split the helper out of this story to dodge the census and do not hand-edit the baseline.
